0.original: Thancred wishes to have a word with the hero of the hour.

24.original: Speak with Alisaie in the Crystarium.

26.original: Speak with the manager of suites in the Pendants.

48.original: It was pure luck that we managed to hold the Eulmorans at bay long enough for you to succeed─but we have earned some good fortune. And while it is plain we've not seen the last of General Ran'jit, I for one am glad to delay our reckoning with him awhile longer.

49.original: It seems I was wrong about your friend. Had Feo Ul not stepped in, you'd be frolicking with the faeries by now.

50.original: I'm going to train harder. Having seen what you've achieved, it's the least I can do.

51.original: Though the battle is over, the war is far from won. Let us fix our gaze upon the road ahead.

52.original: I knew you could do it. And not only because of your blessing. You have a strength all your own, and it has seen us through many a trial.

53.original: With the Warden defeated, I believe our work here is done. It is time we were going─<hex:021A020203>together<hex:021A020103>, needless to say.

54.original: ...To the bitter end─the fate of our two worlds being at stake, and all that.

55.original: Now then, I suggest we hurry back to the Crystarium. Much and more may have happened while we were frolicking with the fae folk.

56.original: That Ran'jit elected to pursue us makes me hopeful the city was spared Eulmore's attentions, but I would sooner see for myself.

57.original: Besides, I believe I speak for us all when I say that I've had a bellyful of Il Mheg. Let us away before the faeries think to play with us again.

58.original: I see nothing out of the ordinary.

59.original: Though we've spent most of our time on the road, Minfilia and I actually have apartments here. Perhaps now we may finally make use of them.

61.original: The city appeareth unchanged from when last I visited. There is the selfsame comforting hum of activity in the air.

62.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? I...I was not expecting you so soon.

63.original: Glad though I am to see you, I daresay you are missed by your comrades. Mayhap you should rejoin them first.

64.original: Finding common ground with an Ascian... My entire being rebels at the very notion.

65.original: He appears to be gone, but I won't be lowering my guard just yet.

66.original: So that was an Ascian... Thancred told me about them.

67.original: That an Ascian of Emet-Selch's standing should willingly reveal himself unto us─and at this of all junctures─is...most interesting.

69.original: Well, we've certainly been given much to ponder, but first things first: we should report to the Exarch.

70.original: You can run along, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. We're perfectly capable of handling this little task.

71.original: In light of your recent exertions, I'd say you've earned a rest.

72.original: Go on, take yourself off to bed. We'll see you later, refreshed and ready for more.

73.original: That your safe and triumphant return should be spoiled by an uninvited guest...

74.original: But let us not dwell on it here and now. I will have the details of your mission from the others. You, meanwhile, should get some rest.

75.original: Ah, welcome back, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. We've been expecting you.

76.original: You will find refreshments laid out in your quarters. We hope they are to your liking.

79.original: Very good, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>. I bid you a pleasant evening.
